meta.name: Crap Happens
meta.description:
Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9

videos.title: Fell Off a Tree Rescuing a Duck
videos.overview: Toni returns to his hometown of Schitten for a family funeral — only to find that he left behind more than just his humdrum life 18 years before.

videos.title: Hi, My Name Is
videos.overview: Thrilled with the newcomer in town, Charly begs his mother to let him get better acquainted, but Toni is set on getting back to his rap career in Berlin.

videos.title: Köbi
videos.overview: Charly suffers an unexpected heartbreak and faces his first archnemesis. Toni struggles with procrastination and returns to songwriting basics.

videos.title: The Circle of Stress
videos.overview: Johnny shares pearls of parenting wisdom, hoping to break the "Circle of Stress." Nancy's sharp policing instincts find her amid a fishy situation.

videos.title: Rick Schmandtke
videos.overview: Toni uses a prized family heirloom to convince top producer Rick Schmandkte to work with him while Charly continues to fight for his attention.

videos.title: The Intervention
videos.overview: Finally with a potential hit on his hands, Toni is shocked to see his family has staged an intervention about his parenting skills... or lack thereof.

videos.title: Gaslight
videos.overview: Toni's lies finally catch up with him when family man and music mogul Dr. Drehws wants to get to know his family over dinner.

videos.title: The Big Performance
videos.overview: Toni's big gig might be his chance to get back on Charly's good side. Nancy uncovers the purple package mystery with the help of an unlikely partner.

videos.title: Armageddon
videos.overview: Concerned with Toni's dwindling positivity, Charly hatches an "Armageddon"-sized plan to get his father's dream back on track.
